Element.Name: UBL version identifier
Element.Description: Identifies the earliest version of the UBL 2 schema for this document type that defines all of the elements that might be encountered in the current instance. Must be "2.4" for documents conforming to this specification.

Element.Name: Specification identification
Element.Description: Identifies the specification of content and rules that apply to the transaction. The value must be the CustomizationID registered for this transaction in the Peppol BIS.

Element.Name: Business process type identifier
Element.Description: Identifies the BIS profile or business process context in which the transaction appears. Used to route the document to the correct processing pipeline.

Element.Name: Document identifier
Element.Description: A transaction instance must contain an identifier. The identifier enables positive referencing of the document instance for various purposes including referencing between transactions that are part of the same process.

Element.Name: Report issue date
Element.Description: The date when this Common Transportation Report is issued. Format = "YYYY-MM-DD".

Element.Name: Document UUID
Element.Description: A universally unique identifier for an instance of this document.

Element.Name: Report issue time
Element.Description: The time when this Common Transportation Report is issued. Format = "hh:mm:ss+hh:mm".

Element.Name: Document status code
Element.Description: A code signifying the status of this Common Transportation Report with respect to its original state. For example: ORIGINAL, REVISED, CANCELLED.

Element.Name: Report type code
Element.Description: A code specifying the type of this Common Transportation Report, such as an eFTI consignment identifier report or a full common transport data set. Use values from the CTRTypeCode code list.

Element.Name: Report type description
Element.Description: Free-form text supplementing cbc:ReportTypeCode, providing a human-readable description of the type of report when the code is not sufficient.
Element.Value: eFTI Consignment Identifier Report — road transport

Element.Name: Description
Element.Description: Free-form text providing a human-readable description of this Common Transportation Report, conveying information not contained explicitly in other structures. Multiple occurrences may be used for multilingual descriptions.
Element.Value: eFTI Common Transportation Report for road consignment DK-2024-12345

Element.Name: Note
Element.Description: Free-form text with supplementary information relevant to this report, such as exceptional circumstances or manual overrides.
Element.Value: Consignment transferred from carrier A to carrier B at border crossing Vaalimaa

Element.Name: Report version identifier
Element.Description: An identifier for the version of this Common Transportation Report. Incremented each time the report is updated or corrected.

Element.Name: Reporter party
Element.Description: The party responsible for compiling and submitting this Common Transportation Report. In the eFTI context this is the certified eFTI platform acting on behalf of the economic operator.

Element.Name: Endpoint ID
Element.Description: Electronic address of the Reporter Party used for routing in the Peppol network.

Element.Name: Reporter party identification
Element.Description: An identifier for the Reporter party.

Element.Name: ID
Element.Description: The identifier of the Reporter party. Use ICD schemeID to qualify the type.

Element.Name: Reporter party name
Element.Description: The name of the Reporter party (the eFTI platform operator).

Element.Name: Postal address
Element.Description: The postal address of the Reporter party.

Element.Name: Address line 1
Element.Description: Street name and number of the Reporter party address.

Element.Name: Country code
Element.Description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

Element.Name: Reporter party legal name
Element.Description: The official registered name of the Reporter party.

Element.Name: Company registration identifier
Element.Description: The legal registration identifier of the Reporter party.

Element.Name: Authority party
Element.Description: The national authority or eFTI Gate that is the recipient of this report and is responsible for verifying eFTI data. In the eFTI context this is typically the national competent authority or the Gate acting on its behalf.

Element.Name: Endpoint ID
Element.Description: Electronic address of the Authority Party used for routing in the Peppol network.

Element.Name: ID
Element.Description: Identifier of the national authority or Gate.

Element.Name: Authority party name
Element.Description: The name of the national authority or Gate.

Element.Name: Sender party
Element.Description: The party sending this Common Transportation Report in the Peppol network. Typically the eFTI platform. Must have a valid Peppol endpoint registration.

Element.Name: Endpoint ID
Element.Description: Electronic address of the Sender Party used for routing in the Peppol network.

Element.Name: Receiver party
Element.Description: The party receiving this Common Transportation Report in the Peppol network. Typically the national Gate or competent authority.

Element.Name: Endpoint ID
Element.Description: Electronic address of the Receiver Party used for routing in the Peppol network.

Element.Name: Reporting location
Element.Description: The location where this Common Transportation Report is generated or made available, such as the eFTI platform's registered place of business or a border crossing point where the inspection is taking place.

Element.Name: Location identifier
Element.Description: An identifier for the reporting location, e.g. UN/LOCODE.

Element.Name: Location name
Element.Description: The name of the location where this report is generated.

Element.Name: Shipment
Element.Description: An identifiable collection of one or more consignments being transported as a unit. Contains the full eFTI Common Transport Data Set mapped to UBL structures.

Element.Name: Shipment identifier
Element.Description: Identifies the shipment. If the ID is in the GSIN format this should be indicated in the attribute @schemeID. The Global Shipment Identification Number (GSIN) is a GS1 key used to identify a shipment assigned by the seller of goods.

Element.Name: Shipment description
Element.Description: Free-form text pertinent to this shipment, conveying information not contained explicitly in other structures.
Element.Value: Road consignment from Copenhagen to Helsinki

Element.Name: Consignment
Element.Description: An identifiable collection of goods items sent from one party (the consignor) to another party (the consignee) via one or more modes of transport. Corresponds to the eFTI SupplyChainConsignment data set as defined in Regulation (EU) 2020/1056, and the UN/CEFACT CCTS SupplyChainConsignment aggregate business information entity.

Element.Name: Consignment identifier (GINC)
Element.Description: The unique identifier of this consignment. If the ID is in the GINC format (Global Identification Number for Consignment) this should be indicated in @schemeID. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.id (UN01004165).

Element.Name: Consignor assigned consignment identifier
Element.Description: A consignment identifier assigned by the consignor. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.consignorAssignedId.

Element.Name: Consignee assigned consignment identifier
Element.Description: A consignment identifier assigned by the consignee.

Element.Name: Consignment gross weight
Element.Description: The total gross weight of all goods items in this consignment including packaging but excluding the tare weight of transport equipment. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.grossWeight. Mandatory if gross volume or loading length is not specified.

Element.Name: Consignment gross volume
Element.Description: The total gross volume of this consignment. Mandatory if gross weight or loading length is not specified.

Element.Name: Loading length measure
Element.Description: The total length in a means of transport needed to accommodate all consignments. Mandatory if gross weight or gross volume is not specified.

Element.Name: Dangerous goods indicator
Element.Description: An indication that the goods in this consignment are subject to an international regulation concerning the carriage of dangerous goods (true) or not (false). Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMovement.dangerousGoodsIndicator.

Element.Name: Total number of transport handling units
Element.Description: The total number of transport handling units (packages, pallets, etc.) in this consignment.

Element.Name: Consignor party
Element.Description: The party that makes the goods available for transport — the sender. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.consignor (UN01004174).

Element.Name: Postal address
Element.Description: The postal address of the consignor. Corresponds to eFTI field: TradeParty.postalAddress / TradeAddress.

Element.Name: Consignee party
Element.Description: The party that receives the goods — the receiver. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.consignee (UN01004180).

Element.Name: Carrier party
Element.Description: The party undertaking or arranging the transport of the goods between named points. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.carrier (UN01004171).

Element.Name: Freight forwarder party
Element.Description: The party responsible for the international transport of goods, often known as the freight forwarder or integrator. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.freightForwarder (UN01004188).

Element.Name: Original departure country
Element.Description: The country from which the goods were originally exported without any commercial transaction taking place in intermediate countries. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.exportCountry.

Element.Name: Final destination country
Element.Description: The country in which the goods are to be delivered to the final consignee or buyer. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.importCountry.

Element.Name: Transport handling unit
Element.Description: The outermost units that the carrier handles — pallets, containers, etc. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.usedTransportEquipment (LogisticsTransportEquipment, UN01003798).

Element.Name: Transport handling unit identifier
Element.Description: The Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) or similar identifier for this transport handling unit. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportEquipment.id (eFTI374).

Element.Name: Transport handling unit type code
Element.Description: The type of transport handling unit. Use UN/ECE Recommendation 21.

Element.Name: Hazardous risk indicator
Element.Description: An indicator that this transport handling unit contains dangerous goods (true) or not (false).

Element.Name: Transport equipment
Element.Description: Transport equipment associated with this handling unit, such as a container or trailer. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportEquipment (ASBIE1086).

Element.Name: Transport equipment identifier
Element.Description: The identifier of the transport equipment, e.g. a container number. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportEquipment.id (eFTI374).

Element.Name: Transport equipment type code
Element.Description: The type of transport equipment. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportEquipment.categoryCode (eFTI378).

Element.Name: Sequence number
Element.Description: A sequence number differentiating this piece of transport equipment from others. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportEquipment.sequenceNumber (eFTI987).

Element.Name: Registration country
Element.Description: The country of registration of this transport equipment. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportEquipment.registrationCountry (ASBIE1097). NOTE: Use cac:ProviderParty/cac:PostalAddress/cac:Country as the UBL carrier for registration country, or add a custom cac:RegistrationCountry extension.

Element.Name: Country code
Element.Description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country where this transport equipment is registered.

Element.Name: Goods item
Element.Description: A goods item contained in this transport handling unit. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignmentItem.

Element.Name: Goods description
Element.Description: A textual description of this goods item.

Element.Name: Hazardous risk indicator
Element.Description: Indicates whether this goods item is subject to dangerous goods regulation.

Element.Name: Gross weight
Element.Description: The gross weight of this goods item.

Element.Name: Item
Element.Description: Structured description of the goods being transported.

Element.Name: Commodity classification
Element.Description: Classification of the goods, e.g. by HS code or UNCL7143.

Element.Name: Associated document reference
Element.Description: Reference to documents associated with this consignment, such as a CMR note, TIR carnet, or dangerous goods declaration. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.associatedDocument (ASBIE1057). NOTE: In UBL 2.4, use cac:ExtraAllowanceCharge is a placeholder — the implementation should use cac:DocumentReference at the root document level.

Element.Name: Shipment stage (transport leg)
Element.Description: A stage of the transport movement, representing one leg of the journey. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.mainCarriageTransportMovement (LogisticsTransportMovement, ASBIE1098). Multiple stages are used when the consignment is carried via several modes of transport.

Element.Name: Transport mode code
Element.Description: A code signifying the mode of transport used for this shipment stage. Use UN/ECE Recommendation 19 (UNECE TransportModeCode). Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMovement.modeCode (eFTI581). 1 = Maritime, 2 = Rail, 3 = Road, 4 = Air, 7 = Fixed transport installations, 8 = Inland waterway.

Element.Name: Transport means
Element.Description: The physical means of transport used in this shipment stage. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMovement.usedTransportMeans (LogisticsTransportMeans, ASBIE1107). Use the appropriate sub-element for the transport mode.

Element.Name: Road transport
Element.Description: A road vehicle transporting the goods. Use only when TransportModeCode = 3 (Road). Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans (road mode).

Element.Name: License plate identifier
Element.Description: The licence plate(s) identifying the road vehicle. If more than one, separate by semicolon. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans.id (eFTI618). Registration country is specified in cac:RegistrationNation.

Element.Name: Air transport
Element.Description: An aircraft used for this shipment stage. Use only when TransportModeCode = 4 (Air).

Element.Name: Aircraft identifier
Element.Description: The registration number of the aircraft. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans.id (eFTI618).

Element.Name: Rail transport
Element.Description: Rail equipment used for this shipment stage. Use only when TransportModeCode = 2 (Rail).

Element.Name: Train identifier
Element.Description: The identifier of the train. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans.id (eFTI618).

Element.Name: Rail car identifier
Element.Description: Identifier of the specific rail car on the train.

Element.Name: Maritime transport
Element.Description: A vessel used for this shipment stage. Use only when TransportModeCode = 1 (Maritime).

Element.Name: Vessel identifier
Element.Description: The IMO number or other registered identifier of the vessel. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans.id (eFTI618).

Element.Name: Vessel name
Element.Description: The name of the vessel.

Element.Name: Transport means registration nationality
Element.Description: The country of registration of the transport means used in this stage. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans.registrationCountry (ASBIE1108 / TradeCountry).

Element.Name: Registration country code
Element.Description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country where the transport means is registered.

Element.Name: Loading location
Element.Description: The location where the goods are loaded onto the transport means for this leg. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMovement.departureEvent/occurrenceLocation.

Element.Name: Location identifier
Element.Description: An identifier for the loading location, e.g. a UN/LOCODE.

Element.Name: Unloading location
Element.Description: The location where the goods are unloaded from the transport means for this leg. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMovement.arrivalEvent/occurrenceLocation.

Element.Name: Transport schedule
Element.Description: Planned departure and arrival times for this transport leg. Corresponds to eFTI fields: LogisticsTransportMovement.departureEvent and LogisticsTransportMovement.arrivalEvent.

Element.Name: Estimated departure date/time
Element.Description: The planned or estimated departure date and time for this leg. Corresponds to eFTI field: TransportEvent.occurrenceDateTime (departureEvent).

Element.Name: Border crossing information
Element.Description: Information about border crossings for this shipment. Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.transitCustomsOfficeLocation.

Element.Name: Transport means
Element.Description: The physical means of transport that is the primary subject of this report. Use this element when the report concerns a specific vehicle, vessel or aircraft independently of the shipment stage structure — e.g. for roadside inspection. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans (ASBIE1107).

Element.Name: Journey identifier
Element.Description: An identifier for the journey made by this means of transport.

Element.Name: Transport means type code
Element.Description: A code signifying the type of this transport means.

Element.Name: Road transport
Element.Description: A road vehicle. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans (road).

Element.Name: License plate identifier
Element.Description: The licence plate of the road vehicle. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans.id (eFTI618).

Element.Name: Owner party
Element.Description: The party owning this means of transport. Corresponds to eFTI field: LogisticsTransportMeans.ownerParty.

Element.Name: Measurement dimension
Element.Description: A measurement of this transport means, e.g. length or capacity.

Element.Name: Additional document reference
Element.Description: Reference to documents relevant for this Common Transportation Report, such as a CMR note, TIR carnet, customs declaration, or the eFTI UIL (Unique Identifier Link). Corresponds to eFTI field: SupplyChainConsignment.associatedDocument (ReferencedDocument).

Element.Name: Document identifier
Element.Description: The reference number or identifier of the associated document.

Element.Name: Document type code
Element.Description: The type of document expressed as a code. Use UNCL1001.

Element.Name: Document type
Element.Description: The type of document in free text when the code is not sufficient.

Element.Name: eFTI UIL
Element.Description: The Unique Identifier Link (UIL) assigned by the eFTI Gate when a consignment is registered. Use DocumentTypeCode = "eFTI-UIL" and provide the UUID here. Required after successful Gate registration.

Element.Name: Signature
Element.Description: A signature applied to this Common Transportation Report by the Reporter Party or another authorised signatory, confirming the authenticity of the data. Corresponds to eFTI field: TradeParty.confirmedDocumentAuthentication.

Element.Name: Signature identifier
Element.Description: The identifier of this signature.

Element.Name: Validation date
Element.Description: The date upon which this signature was verified. Format = "YYYY-MM-DD".

Element.Name: Validation time
Element.Description: The time at which this signature was verified. Format = "hh:mm:ss+hh:mm".

Element.Name: Signatory party
Element.Description: The party applying this signature.

Element.Name: Digital signature attachment
Element.Description: The actual digital signature, embedded or referenced as an attachment.
